intro.tagline: Excellence in the service of your receptions

hero.title: Excellence in the service of your receptions
hero.sub: Weddings, christenings, cocktail parties and business dinners. Food, decor and service, planned together down to the last detail.

trust: Paris, Île-de-France and all of France

services.title: One house for every kind of reception
services.intro: From a drinks reception for three hundred guests to an intimate business lunch, we take care of the table, the setting and the service. You host; we handle the rest.

items.title: Weddings
items.text: Drinks reception, seated dinner or buffets, desserts and wedding cake: a complete reception, from the first glass to the last coffee.

items.title: Cocktail parties
items.text: Savoury and sweet canapés, verrines, a fresh juice bar and dressed buffets, for an evening where guests mingle, taste and talk.

items.title: Business events
items.text: Seminars, launches and client lunches: punctual, discreet catering that reflects the standing of your company.

items.title: Christenings and family
items.text: Christenings, engagements, birthdays and brunches: family occasions served with the same care as a grand wedding.

items.title: Decor
items.text: Centrepieces, tableware and the couple's lounge: we dress the room so it feels like your event.

items.title: Service
items.text: Uniformed head waiters and staff, set-up, plated or buffet service and clearing: a trained, well-coordinated team.

weddings.title: On the day, every moment has its table
weddings.intro: A wedding reception unfolds in stages. We plan the timeline, the menu and the setting of each one with you, so your guests move from one to the next without ever waiting.

steps.title: The drinks reception
steps.text: Canapés, food stations and dressed buffets, a fresh juice bar and soft drinks, served while the photos are taken.

steps.title: The dinner
steps.text: Plated service or grand buffets, depending on your venue and guest count. Starter, main, cheese: the menu is built with you.

steps.title: Dessert
steps.text: Wedding cake, a dessert buffet, petits fours and coffee, to close the evening on a beautiful sweet table.

craft.title: Every service precisely timed, every flavour mastered
paragraphs: A beautiful reception leaves nothing to chance. Before the day, we set the timeline with you minute by minute, the number of canapés per guest, where the buffets go and what each member of the team will do.

Everything is prepared and plated by our own kitchen. In the room, our head waiters know the menu, any allergies you've flagged and the key moments of the evening. All you have to think about is your guests.
